title: Why This Canadian Province Wants To Get The Hell Out
description:
Canada is melting down as Albertans push for independence, and somehow a U.S. Olympic ad featuring Tate McRae helped trigger the panic.

When Alberta pays the bills, Ottawa makes the rules, and a commercial causes an identity crisis, the problem isn’t the ad.
